data.title: 阿尼斯 · 风口的最后一箱
data.description: 风从倾倒的路障中间钻过来，差点揭走最后一只补给箱上的清单。阿尼斯用手套压住纸张，拇指按住肩带的通话键报数。浅灰防风夹克上的黄色救援标带让接应的人能从扬尘里认出她。
data.action: 用手套按住货箱清单，另一手按下肩带上的通话键。
data.promptProse: Beside the last supply crate at an abandoned road checkpoint, she pins a paper manifest under one gloved palm and presses the radio on her harness with the other. Dust crosses the concrete barriers behind her.
data.animaCaption: Her palm keeps the manifest flat while she radios the final count.
